# MolViewer

> Free, open-source 3D molecule viewer that runs in the browser (https://molviewer.bio). View proteins, DNA and RNA from the PDB, AlphaFold predictions, and small molecules from PubChem, or open your own PDB, mmCIF, SDF, MOL or XYZ file. Nothing to install.

## What it does

- Load a structure by PDB ID (from RCSB, downloaded as mmCIF), by UniProt accession (AlphaFold DB prediction), or by compound name or CID (PubChem 3D conformer).
- Open local files: PDB (.pdb), mmCIF (.cif, .mmcif, .cif.gz), SDF, MOL and XYZ.
- Representations: cartoon (helices and β-sheets), ball-and-stick, stick, spacefill, molecular surfaces (van der Waals and solvent-accessible).
- Color schemes: element (CPK), chain, residue type, secondary structure, B-factor (also shows AlphaFold pLDDT confidence), rainbow.
- Measure distances, angles and dihedrals; label atoms; read the sequence with secondary-structure annotation.
- Compare up to 10 structures, overlaid or side by side. Undo/redo, keyboard shortcuts, dark and light themes.
- Share a scene with a short link (/s/...), embed an interactive viewer in any page with an iframe, and export PNG images, turntable videos (WebM/MP4) and 3D models (GLB, STL).

## Useful URLs

- Any PDB entry: https://molviewer.bio/pdb/{PDB_ID}, e.g. https://molviewer.bio/pdb/4HHB. Each page lists the entry's helix and β-strand residue ranges, chains, ligands, citation and related structures.
- Any AlphaFold prediction: https://molviewer.bio/af/{UNIPROT_ACCESSION}, e.g. https://molviewer.bio/af/P04637, with the pLDDT confidence breakdown and matching PDB structures.
- Small molecules: https://molviewer.bio/compound/{name}, e.g. https://molviewer.bio/compound/caffeine. Index: https://molviewer.bio/compounds
- View options as query parameters: ?repr=cartoon|ball-and-stick|stick|spacefill|surface-vdw|surface-sas and ?color=cpk|chain|residueType|secondaryStructure|bfactor|rainbow, e.g. https://molviewer.bio/pdb/1CRN?repr=cartoon&color=secondaryStructure
- Embeddable viewer: https://molviewer.bio/embed/pdb/{PDB_ID} (also /embed/af/..., /embed/compound/...), with ?spin=1 and ?bg=light. oEmbed: https://molviewer.bio/oembed?url=...
- Topic collections: https://molviewer.bio/collections
- Guides: https://molviewer.bio/learn (reading PDB files, helices and β-sheets, AlphaFold models, pLDDT)
- Format-specific viewers: /pdb-viewer, /alphafold-viewer, /mmcif-viewer, /sdf-viewer, /xyz-viewer; comparison with other tools: /compare

## Technology

React 19, TypeScript, Three.js with React Three Fiber, Zustand, Vite; hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Source code (MIT): https://github.com/GlebShulga/molviewer
